title: Track a simulated owner count
description: You can separate the explicit registry counter from Python's own reference-count observations.

steps.description: RCObject creates a registry entry with count 1. addref explicitly increments that simulated count.
release decrements the count and removes the registry entry at zero. The printed freed message describes this simulation, not proof that every Python reference disappeared.

steps.question: What simulated count follows two addref calls?

steps.description: The three release calls take the simulated count through 2, 1, and 0. The recording then prints its destruction message.
The final section asks sys.getrefcount about a string around alias changes. Those observations belong to the supplied runtime recording rather than the explicit RCObject counter.
